rule: Choose the smallest positive multiple of 256 rows N covering at least 99.5% of all CPU-tokenized text tokens in these complete files, weighted by token count. No BOS/EOS/chat template is added. Cap at full vocabulary. Do not change rule/files after observing token IDs.
independence: Fixed general lab operations, publication rules and storage code. No benchmark prompts, outputs, packet49 oracle, or packet55 outputs used in selection. Text-token exclusion is a proxy, not measured generated-target or draft acceptance.
post_selection_only: Benchmark output coverage may only be inspected after selection.json is fixed.
